question: The period of first five year plan was between ________.
solution:
The correct answer is __**1951-1956.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The **first five year plan** was launched by the **government of India** in **1951 **with the aim of developing the **economy and reducing poverty.**
 
• The plan was based on the **Soviet model **of **economic development **and focused on **agriculture, irrigation, power generation, and infrastructure.**
 
• The plan was largely successful in achieving its targets and laid the foundation for **India's economic growth** in the subsequent decades.
 
• The plan was followed by four more five year plans until **1978, **after which the government shifted to a rolling plan approach.
 
• **Option 2 **(1910-1915), **option 3** (1960-1965), and** option 4** (1980-1985) are** incorrect** as they do not correspond to the period of the first five year plan in India.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The **Soviet model of economic development** involved a **centralized planning system,** state ownership of **key industries,** and emphasis on **heavy industry.**
 
• **Option 2 (**1910-1915) is **incorrect** as India was still under British colonial rule during that period and did not have the autonomy to launch a five year plan.
 
• **Option 3** (1960-1965) is **incorrect** as it corresponds to the third five year plan in India.
 
• **Option 4 **(1980-1985) is **incorrect **as it corresponds to the seventh five year plan in India.
